title: The best drummers: Dave Benny and Facer
summary: Barnes praises Dave Benny, who danced with his drums, and Facer as the best drummers he sat next to.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Who were some of the real steady drummers in that time, speaking of drummers? You know, they'd kept good time. Well I'm going to tell you about that. To my journey.

There's no drum player in this town right now, who plays much drum for me, is Dave Benny. Now I'm telling you my cousin Cy, and Alfred and all them, I'm telling you Dave Benny. Now I know how y'all feel about everybody else. Was he flashy or a straight drummer? He was everything. Everything? He was everything. David get half by their drums and he started to dance with them and he had to do that. They'd do that. Can they like it? Yeah, they'd explode, man. It was round. That's the only drummer I see all the men's plays in that drum. They'd sit on, take them up and on. But they would dance. They and the boy called Facer went away from me. Facer? Facer. Them the two best drummers that I ever sat on the outside of. They were dead. They and the boy called Facer went away from me. Facer? Facer. Those are the two best drummers that I ever sat on the outside of. Those are the men, nice men, played plenty drums. Know? Them two men to me.
